args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The docstring specified ROUND_HALF_EVEN but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing nightly test failures in tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite the docstring (and FIN-212) specifying banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Changes
- Switch rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/fin-212-round-half-even` (commit `08d3cd5986`) passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

References FIN-212.
args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even

2. **Fixed it** on branch `fix/fin-212-round-half-even` — changed the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
